subject: Priority sprint: canary run & QBR prep — wins, risks, asks
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Sloane Carter <sloane@acmecloud.com>, procurement@triton.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Priority sprint: canary run & QBR prep — wins, risks, asks

Team — quick weekly snapshot ahead of the exec sync at 2pm PT. TL;DR: Canary is green on perf, we have one outstanding procurement blocker for Acme deal, and the QBR deck draft is ready for leadership review. Action items at the bottom.

Wins:
- Canary deployment (region-us-west-2) completed overnight; steady-state p95 latency ~56ms (target 60ms). Logging and tracing hooks validated.
- OKR progress: Serving runtime batching improvements moved 14% of requests into 2x efficiency lane (KR1.2).
- CS ran a trial prompt set with Acme; qualitative feedback: latency/consistency meet their needs.

Risks / Blockers:
- Procurement: Triton-issued SOW redline still outstanding (legal + procurement loop). This prevents signing the Dedicated contract that funds Q3 runway for the capacity commit.
- Canary load generator does not cover sustained long-tail session churn (we saw a small memory spike on node-4 at t+3h). Need ops triage.
- QBR deck: two slides (cost model and commit economics) need final numbers from finance (Marissa) before 12pm tomorrow to incorporate into exec pack.

Asks (owners + ETA):
- Marissa: finalize QBR cost slides with committed Dedicated pricing and margin impact by 12:00 PDT 2027-07-20. (Marissa)
- Karthik / Infra: run extended churn soak on the canary cluster and check node-4 traces + heap dump; share findings by EOD today. (Karthik)
- Laura: high-level 3-slide narrative for the QBR customer health call (Acme spotlight) — draft by noon tomorrow. (Laura)
- Legal / Procurement: Sloane, can you confirm if your procurement team can accept our standard data-retention appendix? If not, loop in legal for a quick redline call. (Sloane / Triton)

Attachments: QBR-OKR-deck-v2.pdf (draft), production-canary-runbook.md (operational runbook stub).

Notes:
- I will be on the 2pm exec sync; please be prepared to speak to your asks for 3 minutes.

— Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Operations & Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Sloane Carter <sloane@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Priority sprint: canary run & QBR prep — wins, risks, asks

Thanks, Irene — concise and useful. A few quick notes:

- Happy about the canary numbers; I'll pull a 2-slide customer health snapshot for Acme linking latency to usage tiers (will include the CS trial notes).
- For the QBR narrative I’ll highlight the routing/fallbacks that kept the trial within SLOs (short bullet + callout).

I can take the lead on the Acme messaging in the pack. Will share a draft slide by 11am PT tomorrow.

— Laura
Laura Bennett

Subject: Re: Priority sprint: canary run & QBR prep — wins, risks, asks

Irene / team — quick ops update from infra: we ran a synthetic churn scenario this morning for 2h and observed the same memory uplift on node-4 at 1.8h. Heap profile shows increased short-lived allocations tied to KV cache rehydration under churn.

Planned next steps:
- Will trigger an extended 8h soak from 11:30am PT with enhanced sampling and heap dumps every hour. (ETA: 7:45pm PT today for initial report)
- If we reproduce, we'll push a targeted hotfix to the cache rehydration path and run a narrow canary (3 nodes) tomorrow AM.

Ask: need permission to increase canary node quota by +3 GPUs for the extended soak to simulate realistic concurrency. Cost center: Q3 product validation (use commit code PROD-VAL-721). Please confirm.

— Karthik
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Sloane / Triton procurement — appreciate the quick heads up on paperwork. If there are non-starters in the SOW redline, let's schedule a 30-min call tomorrow 10:30am PT with legal and procurement to resolve outstanding items. If that time doesn't work, propose an alternate window.

I'll attach the latest QBR deck and the canary runbook for reference (lightweight). Please review the cost slide and Acme narrative before our exec sync.
